recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-14848 unless a later final FHIR-I decision changes how per-server SearchParameter conformance is represented.
issue_request: FHIR-14848 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I request from the STU3 ballot to let implementations indicate whether logical AND and/or OR combinations are supported for search parameters. Although the description pointed at CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.searchParam, the accepted resolution was to add the ability to indicate OR and AND support to SearchParameter.
initial_application: Jira comments identify svn revision 13220. In git history, f0ec862a5f986e3a82bb9ef1a4fa32619c65d6e1 maps to build@13220 and explicitly mentions GF#14848; its patch added SearchParameter.multipleOr and SearchParameter.multipleAnd rows to the then-authoritative SearchParameter source.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists both CapabilityStatement and SearchParameter as active resources. Current SearchParameter source defines multipleOr and multipleAnd with meaningWhenMissing text saying omitted support is up to server discretion. CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.searchParam names supported search parameters and references SearchParameter definitions for detailed behavior. Later FHIR-40328 clarified missing-value semantics, FHIR-42931 audited rendered multiples behavior and is already represented on the combined branch, and FHIR-20471 handled conformance expectation extension context and is also already represented.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative source already carries the accepted FHIR-14848 AND/OR support indicators on SearchParameter, and adding duplicate fields to CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.searchParam would diverge from the accepted resolution and current model.

related_jiras.note: Clarified meaningWhenMissing for SearchParameter.multipleOr and SearchParameter.multipleAnd; remaining warning work is outside this seed decision.
Confirmed omitted multipleAnd/multipleOr values mean server discretion in rendered search pages; already represented on the combined branch.
Later addressed conformance expectation extension use on SearchParameter; already represented on the combined branch.
